subject.title: fix: preserve history across bounded imports

question: Should existing import automation change from replacement to preservation by default, with destructive synchronization requiring the new `--replace` flag?
rationale: Preservation prevents the reported data loss, but the default transition intentionally changes repeat-import semantics and can retain deleted or out-of-window rows.

options.title: Preserve By Default
options.body: Accept merge-by-default as the safer archive contract and clearly announce that exact replacement now requires `--replace`.

options.title: Retain Replacement Default
options.body: Make preservation opt-in to avoid automation changes, while retaining the current destructive default.

recommendation.title: Preserve By Default
recommendation.body: Accept merge-by-default as the safer archive contract and clearly announce that exact replacement now requires `--replace`.
